top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a complete, mature chain from physiology to patient outcome: Holst on GLP-1 secretion and glucose-dependent action in humans, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide biology and receptor pharmacology, and Mojsov on identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) form. Independent randomised trials have confirmed metabolic, cardiovascular and renal benefit, so the timing is not premature. The three-name allocation fits the cap and the citation stays on the physiology and active peptide, not on particular drugs. Mojsov's contested priority and the exclusion of Knudsen are real costs, but they do not outweigh the achievement, so I rank it above no award.
